raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi" %}
{% set version = "0.65b0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/opentelemetry_instrumentation_fastapi-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 10a3a95486036230413a58fe4fdf4a83fa6bba46918407e527476994bd92bd97

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - opentelemetry-api ~=1.12
    - opentelemetry-instrumentation-asgi ==0.65b0
